title: Mahindra sold 6,15,280 SUVs in India in Jan-Oct 2026 (domestic wholesales), +19% from 5,18,321, its second calendar year in a row past 6 lakh (CY2025 record 6,25,603); October 2026's 73,338 is its highest-ever month; Tata Motors is No. 2 behind Maruti in 2026 with 6,49,477 by October, 34,197 ahead, and beat Mahindra in October by 556 (73,894 vs 73,338)
